    • processQueries

      public void processQueries(Collection<? extends AdaptiveQuery<I,O>> queries)
      Description copied from interface: AdaptiveMembershipOracle
      Processes the specified collection of queries. When this method returns, the provided inputs of the AdaptiveQuery.getInput() method will have been evaluated on the system under learning and its responses will have been forwarded to the AdaptiveQuery.processOutput(Object) method until the method has returned AdaptiveQuery.Response.FINISHED.
      Specified by:
      processQueries in interface AdaptiveMembershipOracle<I,O>
      Parameters:
      queries - the queries to process
